name: r8-stale-or-foreign-next-token-is-stale-target
note: next is opaque and bound to the attachment, conversation, target (session and process generation), selector and the history snapshot it continues. Used in another conversation, altered, or after the message it continues from was evicted (or after a history reload, or another runtime), it is chat error stale_target, sequenced, and no page is sent; the client starts a new selection. A lookup whose turn is no longer retained is not an error: an empty page with coverage unavailable and end: true. A turn whose oldest messages were evicted (turn-38 lost m-0075) is coverage partial.
